Name: Stack More Things
Author: advanlsdnfa
Description:
[size=6][b]Stack More Things[/b][/size]

Mod that allows you to stack things like furniture, tackle, clothing, etc. Also lets you adjust the maximum stack size for everything, merge crops of different colors into one stack, and reduce the quality of items so they can be stacked.

Multiplayer has been reported as working.

[b][size=4]Translations[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Chinese - thanks to anonymous user
[*]French - thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DollyGethFR]DollyGethFR[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size]
Supports Generic Mod Config Menu
[list]
[*]MaxStackSize - adjust the maximum stack size for all items (default 9999)
[*]EnableComplexPatches - enables changes that allow for correct handling of tackle usage, furniture placement, forging, tailoring, etc. This should usually be turned on, but if you encounter bugs, turn this off.
[/list]
There is one option for each of the previously unstackable things and are all enabled by default:
[list]
[*] Boots
[*] Clothing
[*] Furniture
[*] Hats
[*] Weapons
[*] Rings
[*] Tackle
[*]Tools
[*] Trinkets
[*]> Aggressive Trinket Stacking - Reduces restrictions on which Ice Rods and Magic Quivers can stack with each other so the stats do not need to be the same, only the display name (ex Perfect, Heavy, etc).  Stats for trinkets that get stacked due to this are not preserved.  This should generally be false unless you have a lot of trinkets (default: false).
[*]Wallpaper
[/list]
Two keybinds for merging colors and reducing quality:
[list]
[*] ColorMergeKey - default F10
[*] QualityReduceKey - default F9
[/list]Hold down these keys while organizing your inventory and chests to merge all colors of one crop into one so they can be stacked, or to reduce the quality of everything to none so they can be stacked.

You have to hold down the hot key AND click the organize chest button (or organize inventory button), and the stacks have to be in the same chest or inventory.  It won't work if you just press the hotkey or if you hold down the hotkey and use your mouse to add the stacks together or if you hold down the hotkey and click stash to chest. 

[b][size=4]Expected Behavior[/size][/b]
Some notes on expected behavior:
Things that do not stack:
[list]
[*]Dressers and fish tanks with things inside
[*]Combined rings made of different rings
[*]Weapons and tools with different enchantments
[*]Fishing rods that can have bait or tackle
[*]Clothing of different color
[*]Different colors of Cornucopia bell peppers (this may change in the future)
[/list]You can wear multiple rings and boots, but the effects will not stack
Tackle will prioritize being placed on empty tackle spots if there are any 

[size=4][b]Known Incompatibilities[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14865]Omni-Tools[/url]﻿ - When you unstack the tools from the Omni Tool stack, they disappear instead of being unstacked.  I haven't tested this, but you can try disabling the option for tools﻿
[/list]

Thanks to the Stardew Valley discord for their help with answering questions and code review.

Please let me know if you see any bugs.
